marks_structure.practical_paper: None — Political Science mein practical nahi hota, sirf theory 80 + internal 20.
marks_structure.extra_time_note: Haan — 15 minute reading time milta hai. Is time mein paper padho, Section C/D ke OR options mein se kaunsa attempt karoge decide karo, aur map work ke liye countries yaad karo.

paper_overview.sets_note: RBSE mein multiple sets hote hain. Har set mein same questions, sirf order alag.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono allowed. Mixed bhi chalega. Agar Hindi aur English mein koi contradiction ho toh Hindi version ko valid mana jaata hai (paper mein likha rehta hai).
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Question 14 se Question 20 tak internal choice (अथवा/OR option) milta hai. Matlab Section C, Section D aur Map work mein choice hai.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: RBSE Political Science ka syllabus NCERT ki 2 books par based hai — Book 1 'Contemporary World Politics' aur Book 2 'Politics in India Since Independence'. Dono books ke saare chapter zaroor padho. Navbodh Pariksha Saar ya SBPD jaise RBSE guide books bhi help karte hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Political Science mein 7 types ke questions: MCQ (1), Fill Blank (1), VSA (1), Short Answer (2), Long Answer (3), Essay (4), Map Work (1×4=4).

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf sahi option (A/B/C/D ya अ/ब/स/द) likho. No explanation needed.
types.mostly_from: Saare 18 chapters — dates, events, leaders, treaties, organizations ke quick facts.

types.how_to_attempt: Blank mein sahi shabd/saal/naam bharo. Spelling correct honi chahiye.
Ek shabd ya ek line mein answer. Long answer likhne ki zaroorat nahi.
types.mostly_from: Full forms (SAARC, EVM, NATO), definitions (globalization, bahujan), dates, founder names.

types.how_to_attempt: 2-3 points mein short answer. Definition + 2 examples ya 2 reasons format best hai.
types.mostly_from: Soviet disintegration consequences, India-neighbor relations, dal-badal, privy purse, emergency lessons, coalition politics impact.

types.how_to_attempt: 4-5 points mein answer. Introduction + body + conclusion structure use karo.
types.mostly_from: European Union/ASEAN objectives, India-China/Sri Lanka relations, Kyoto Protocol, Mandal Commission, Kerala Model, Goa liberation, regional aspirations.

types.how_to_attempt: Proper essay structure — intro, 3-4 body paragraphs with sub-headings, conclusion. Ideally 2-3 pages.
types.mostly_from: End of Bipolarity/Shock Therapy, Security concepts (traditional/non-traditional), Human Rights, 1974 movements (Gujarat+Bihar), Post-emergency politics, Coalition politics since 1989, Partition consequences.

types.how_to_attempt: World political map mein 4 countries ko correctly identify karke number likhna hai. Sharp pencil use karo, number spasht likho.
types.mostly_from: Major world countries — USA, Russia, China, Japan, UK, France, Germany, SAARC nations (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, Afghanistan), ASEAN nations, Middle East (Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, Israel), Korea (North/South), Australia, Brazil, Egypt, Spain, Norway.

paper_pattern.note: RBSE Political Science theory paper = 80 marks. 4 sections, 20 questions total. Duration: 3 hours 15 minutes (including 15 min reading time). NCERT 2 books ke saare 18 chapters se questions aate hain.
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Question 14 se Question 20 tak internal choice (अथवा/OR option) milta hai. Matlab Section C, Section D aur Map work mein choice hai.

one_mark_question_facts.note: Objective section of paper covers MCQs, fill blanks, T/F, match, one-word.

important_formula_sheets.note: Not typically applicable for Political Science (humanities subject).

paper_difficulty_analysis.note: Political Science Chemistry/Physics ki tarah conceptual nahi hai — mostly memory-based hai. Hard work karne walon ke liye 70+ marks achievable hai.
most_scoring_sections: Easy — agar NCERT padhi hai toh 30+ out of 36 easily. Dates, names, facts based.
Easy-Medium — 2 mark short answers, thoda structured likhna padta hai
most_difficult_sections: Medium-Hard — 4 marks essay requires thorough understanding. Map work practice-dependent.

tips: Dates aur naam zaroor likho — Political Science mein precision matter karti hai
Essay mein sub-headings use karo (bold ya underline) — examiner ko structure spasht dikhta hai
Map work last mein karo — kyunki agar time kam ho toh bhi pencil-mark jaldi ho jaata hai
Section A mein 1 minute se zyada mat lagao — 36 questions 50 min mein complete karne hain
Internal choice (Q14-20) mein wahi option choose karo jo better yaad hai — doubtful topic mat lo
Globalization, Emergency, Partition, Soviet disintegration — in 4 topics ki thorough tayyari har year important rehti hai
Hindi-English paper mein likhna ho toh Hindi version follow karo (conflict mein Hindi valid hoti hai)
Word limit ka dhyan rakho — Section B 50 words, C 100 words, D 250 words
Reading time mein map ke countries mentally locate karo — actual writing time bachega
Previous Year Papers (2024, 2025, 2026) zaroor solve karo — repetition pattern clear ho jaayega
Current affairs ka zyada stress mat lo — paper NCERT-based static hota hai
Agar pura essay nahi aata toh jitna aata hai structured likho — partial marks milte hain

time_allocation.note: Paper padho. Section C aur D ke OR options mein se kaunsa attempt karoge decide karo. Map work mein diye countries dekho — kaunsa set choose karoge socho. Essay ke liye structure mentally bana lo.
36 objective questions. MCQ + Fill blank + VSA = 1 mark each. 1 question 1-1.5 minute mein. Jaldi karo, confident ho toh. Confusion ho toh skip karo aur baad mein lauto.
10 short answers × 4 min. Concept + 2 points format. 50 words ke around likho.
4 long answers × 8-9 min. Internal choice — jo acche se aata hai wo choose karo. Introduction + 3-4 points + conclusion.
2 essays (20-25 min each) + map work (10-15 min). Essay proper structure mein likho — intro, body with sub-headings, conclusion. Map last mein — sharp pencil se clearly mark karo.
Answer numbers check karo, map work verify karo, essay ka conclusion check karo.

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 15 minute reading time milta hai — is time mein sirf paper padho, answers likhna nahi.

answer_sheet_rules: question_number_note: Har answer se pehle question ka number zaroor likho (Q1, Q2, etc.). Nahi likhne se marks cut ho sakte hain.
sequence_note: Strict sequence mein answer dene ki zaroorat nahi. Lekin multi-part questions (i, ii, iii) ek saath hi likhna — yeh rule paper mein likha hua hai.
reading_time_note: 15 minute reading time mein sirf paper padho — likhna nahi.
mcq_attempt_all: No negative marking — saare 36 Section A questions zaroor attempt karo, even agar guess karna pade.
hindi_english_contradiction: Agar Hindi aur English versions mein koi difference ho, Hindi version valid mana jaata hai (paper mein General Instruction #5 mein likha rehta hai).
word_limit_strict: Word limits strict nahi hoti, but bahut zyada ya bahut kam likhne se marks cut ho sakte hain. Target maintain karo.

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Royal Blue'] pencil_use: Sirf map work (Q20) aur underlining ke liye. Main answers pen se likhna zaroori. map_instruction: World map par sharp pencil se points/numbers mark karo — clearly visible hone chahiye.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: essays: Essay (Section D) mein proper structure — Introduction + 3-4 body paragraphs with sub-headings + Conclusion. 250 words target. short_answers: Section B mein 50 words. Concept define karo + 2 key points ya examples. long_answers: Section C mein 100 words. Introduction + 3-4 points + brief conclusion. map_work: World map par number/arrow clearly likho. 4 countries ko unke approximate locations pe mark karo. Sharp pencil use karo. dates_compulsory: Historical questions mein dates zaroor likho (jaise 1947 partition, 1962 China war, 1971 Bangladesh, 1975 Emergency, 1991 disintegration). Dates yaad karo. partial_marking: True partial_marking_note: Agar essay ya long answer mein kuch points sahi hain, unke marks milte hain. Blank chhodne se behtar hai kuch bhi likho.
